project_type: Google Colab notebook script for AI video generation using LTX-2 19B model via ComfyUI nodes
build_system: None (Colab notebook - pip install at runtime, shell commands for setup)
test_framework: None (manual verification - script is a Colab notebook, no test suite)
verification_instructions: 1. Run AST parse to confirm valid Python syntax. 2. Verify file structure matches Colab cell layout with @title markers. 3. Check all required features are present (CharacterBible, VisionDescribe, EasyPrompt, generate_clip, ProductionEngine).
setup_instructions: No setup needed - this is a standalone .py file that self-installs in Colab.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages or run ComfyUI. Validation must use AST parsing only. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: Single file output: /projects/sandbox/ms/LTX_Studio_Pipeline.py. Must be syntactically valid Python. Must follow Colab cell marker convention (# @title, # @markdown).
key_patterns: 1. CLIP-first-then-UNet memory pattern (load CLIP, encode, delete CLIP, then load UNet). 2. aggressive_cleanup() between stages. 3. ResizeImageMaskNode.EXECUTE_NORMALIZED() with 'scale dimensions' for I2V. 4. Two-pass sampling: Pass1 (euler + ManualSigmas) then Pass2 (gradient_estimation + LTXVLatentUpsampler). 5. NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS dict for ComfyUI node access. 6. get_value_at_index() for node output extraction. 7. CharacterBible injects [NON-NEGOTIABLE] block into prompts. 8. Last-frame extraction via cv2.VideoCapture for scene chaining. 9. VisionDescribeEngine uses Qwen2.5-VL standalone. 10. EasyPromptEngine uses abliterated LLMs for prompt expansion.
directory_structure: /projects/sandbox/ms/ - flat directory containing .py pipeline scripts and .json workflow files
